name: Therapy
overview: Scripture reveals that true therapy and healing come from the Lord, who strengthens and restores health to the afflicted, as seen in Psalms 41:3 and Jeremiah 30:17. While human counsel is valuable and provides safety in times of trouble (Proverbs 11:14), the ultimate Counselor and source of peace is Christ Himself, who invites the weary to find rest in Him (Isaiah 9:6; Matthew 11:28). Transformation and renewal of the mind through God's will are essential for genuine change and healing (Romans 12:2).
